messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} would you
take a look at this letter
I got from a friend?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} kas sa
vaataksid seda kirja,
mille ma sõbralt sain?

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 14 00} a friend
of mine sent me this
letter here.

{07 00 00}Hi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} {07 0b 00}Would you
like to see something? {01 00 00 0a 00}Of
course you would.
{07 16 00}This super weird letter{01 00 00 05 00}
just appeared in my mailbox
one day.

{07 00 00}By the way, {04 1f 00}, I
just gotta show you this
weird letter I got!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Muide, {04 1f 00}, ma pean
sulle näitama seda
imelikku kirja, mille sain!

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}So, what do you think of
it?{02 01 00 05 06 07}
Sounds friendly!
Not good...
Why?
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Nii, mida sa sellest
arvad?{02 01 00 05 06 07}
Kõlab sõbralikult!
Pole hea...
Miks?

messages.en:
{07 09 00}Oh.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} I just wanted your
opinion, is all. {07 1b 00}I've been
craving some excitement.
I was hoping that this
letter had a coded message
that you could help decode.
{07 01 00}Ugh!{01 00 00 0f 00} There's absolutely no
excitement in real life,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!{07 15 00}
messages.et:
{07 09 00}Oh.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Ma tahtsin lihtsalt su
arvamust, ongi kõik. {07 1b 00}Ma olen
igatsenud natuke põnevust.
Ma lootsin, et selles
kirjas on kodeeritud sõnum,
mille sa aitaksid lahti
muukida. {07 01 00}Öök!{01 00 00 0f 00} Pärismaailmas
pole täiesti mingit
põnevust, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!{07 15 00}

messages.en:
{07 1b 00}You see?{01 00 00 14 00} You really gotta
focus when you're reading
it!
{06 00 00 0b 0c}
messages.et:
{07 1b 00}Näed?{01 00 00 14 00} Sa pead tõesti
keskenduma, kui seda
loed!
{06 00 00 0b 0c}

messages.en:
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Writing me a letter like
this must be really boring.{01 01 00}
{07 1b 00}And I must be really bored,
too, 'cause I'm actually
showing you this snoozefest
of a letter!
messages.et:
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Sellise kirja kirjutamine
mulle peab olema tõeliselt
igav.{01 01 00} {07 1b 00}Ja mul peab ka igav
olema, sest ma tõesti
näitan sulle seda
uinutavat kirja!

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Do you think it was a
practical joke or something
else?
{07 14 00}I kept it because it was
kinda funny, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Kas sinu arust oli see
vempu või midagi
muud? {07 14 00}Ma
jätsin selle alles, sest see
oli üsna naljakas, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 15 00}It's a very weird letter, 
{07 19 00}but in some ways, it's right
on target!
{07 14 00}Oh, well,{01 00 00 05 00} whatever{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} It's
kind of funny, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}See on väga imelik kiri,
{07 19 00}aga mõnes mõttes on see
täpselt sihis!
{07 14 00}No mis seal,{01 00 00 05 00} ükskõik{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} See
on üsna naljakas, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:

something?{01 01 00} {07 16 00}It sounds kinda

messages.et:
